description: This file defines the LocationCaptureManager class, which manages location retrieval by checking permissions, accessing location providers, and formatting location data as a JSON payload. It includes functions to get the last known location or request a current location with timeout handling.

classes.name: LocationCaptureManager
classes.description: Manages obtaining device location with permission checks, provider selection, and timeout handling, returning location data formatted as JSON.

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Suspends execution to retrieve the location, either from cache or by requesting a new location, and formats the data as a JSON payload.

methods.name: bestLastKnown
methods.description: Returns the most recent cached location that is within the max age limit, after checking permissions.

methods.name: requestCurrent
methods.description: Requests a new current location from the specified provider within the given timeout, handling permissions and provider availability.
